github.description: GitHub REST API, repository-scoped: repositories, commits, tags, releases, issues.

recording.reason: Recorded in the source project against a real token. api.github.com answers these reads unauthenticated, but at 60 requests an hour per runner IP, so a credential-free re-record from CI is not dependable.

kraken.description: Kraken Spot: REST, WebSocket v2 streams and WebSocket trading RPC.

recording.reason: The 13 endpoints without recordings need an API key, account state or a real order; the other 62 were recorded in the source project. Nothing here is reachable credential-free.
